title: 第5章 重返溶洞惊遇虎第6章 蛤蟆老爷大白兔
content_zh:
曾几何时莫凡幻想过自己还能够融入人类的社会中去，但在差点沦为“仙女姐姐”的丹药后，他也就绝了这个想法。
“妈了个巴子的，既然这辈子做不了人，那老子就做一个自由自在的妖好了！”
“西游记里那只猴子不也挺好的吗？”
“我莫凡也要学一学那只猴子，争取在这个世界闯出属于自己的一番天地，成为一个顶天立地的大圣！”
“这样也就不枉妖生了！”
莫凡自言自语，吃饱喝足后便躺在草地上，一边畅想着未来，一边听着流水声，不一会儿就进入了梦乡。
经过了这一整天的折腾，从惊喜到绝望，再从绝望到兴奋，这种大起大落让莫凡心身俱疲。
梦中，他看到自己成为了一个妖族大圣，甚至与齐天大圣孙悟空称兄道弟，与牛魔王把酒言欢，直到孙悟空告诉他要一起去大闹天宫……
莫凡醒了，是被惊醒的，嘴里骂骂咧咧。
“老子好不容易才从这个操蛋的世界化了妖，你一句话就让老子去大闹天宫，还让不让老子活了？！”
莫凡的确羡慕西游记里的齐天大圣，但并不羡慕他大闹天宫，这在他看来是愚蠢的，放着好好的妖王不去当，闹什么天宫啊！
搞得自己最后被镇压在了五指山下足足五百年，即便脱困后也被紧箍咒给磨尽了锐气，成为了一条听话的狗！
所以打死他也不要去闹什么天宫！
“原来是个梦，吓死老子了！”
莫凡清醒后拍了拍胸脯，旋即便开始思考今后的路。
既然走上了妖怪的路子，那眼目前也只好继续走下去，不过对于修行莫凡却是一窍不通，虽然化妖是吃灵果造成的，可这让他到哪里去找灵果？
靠吃灵果修行显然是不现实的，所以当务之急还是要找个靠山才行，最好是去投奔一方大妖，这样才能有机会获得真正属于妖怪的修行法门。
还有那本自小丫头那里顺来的书也有必要尽早翻译出来，说不准就是一本修炼功法呢？
他隐约记得那女魔头说过似乎是什么魔道修士的呼吸法门，应该就是与修行有关的。
想到这里，莫凡又不禁自语道：“人类的修炼法门，妖怪能修吗？”

在思考了半晌后，摆在莫凡面前的便是两条路，一条是去寻找人类，然后学习练字，将那本书上的内容给解决了。
另一条路则是去寻找大妖作为靠山，弄到妖修法门。
可当他看了一眼周围这深山老林的环境，便知道无论哪一条路似乎都不太好走。
“算了，还是先找到回洞穴的路，那三块石头必须收回体内空间，这样一来便可利用金钱币复制出更多！”
在莫凡看来那乳白色石头肯定不是凡物，可能以后能够有所用途。
当然，他也不仅仅是想要回去取那三块石头，还有那座充满乳白色石头的溶洞，倒是值得再去探一探。
就这样，莫凡直接顺着溪流向远处飘去。
因为在他看来自己洞穴所在的小溪，很可能和这条小溪是同一条！
虽然这种猜测是靠蒙的，结果却还真被莫凡给蒙对了。
在随着小溪漂流了整整两天后，他终于看到了熟悉的环境，心中却是惊喜不已。
当莫凡再度回到以前所居住的洞穴时，才郁闷的发现自己已经进不去了，因为此刻他的体型比之前要大太多。
最后莫凡只能忍痛挖呀挖呀挖，硬是将自己居住了数月的家给挖没了……
不过看到那三块散发着淡淡光晕的乳白色石头后，莫凡心中顿时轻松了不少。
“还好，都还在！”
他张口间便将这三块石头收入了体内空间，接着又取出一块含在嘴里，便毫不留恋地朝那个溶洞的方向再度走去。
content_en:
There was a time when Mo Fan imagined that he could integrate into human society, but after almost becoming a "fairy sister", he gave up this idea.
"Damn it, since I can't be a human being in this life, then I'll just be a free monster!"
"Isn't that monkey in Journey to the West pretty good too?"
"I, Mo Fan, also want to learn from that monkey and strive to carve out my own world in this world and become a great sage who is upright and upright!"
"This way, the demon's birth will not be in vain!"
Mo Fan muttered to himself. After eating and drinking, he lay down on the grass, thinking about the future while listening to the sound of running water, and soon fell asleep.
After a whole day of tossing, from surprise to despair, and then from despair to excitement, this ups and downs made Mo Fan exhausted both physically and mentally.
In the dream, he saw that he had become a great sage of the demon race, and even called himself a brother-in-law with Monkey King, Monkey King, and had a good time with the Bull Demon King until Sun Wukong told him that they would go to the Heavenly Palace together to cause havoc...
Mo Fan woke up, he was woken up, and he was cursing.
"I finally turned into a monster from this fucked up world. You just said a word and asked me to go make trouble in heaven. Are you going to let me live?!"
Mo Fan does envy the Monkey King in Journey to the West, but he doesn’t envy him for making trouble in the Heavenly Palace. This seems to him stupid. If you don’t become a good demon king, why bother making trouble in the Heavenly Palace!
As a result, he was finally suppressed at the foot of Wuzhi Mountain for five hundred years. Even after he escaped, he was worn down by the tight curse and became an obedient dog!
So if you beat him to death, don’t go and cause trouble in heaven!
"It turned out to be a dream, I was scared to death!"
After Mo Fan woke up, he patted his chest and immediately began to think about the future.
Now that he has embarked on the path of a monster, he has no choice but to keep going. However, Mo Fan knows nothing about cultivation. Although the transformation into a monster is caused by eating spiritual fruits, where can he find spiritual fruits?
It is obviously unrealistic to practice by eating spiritual fruits, so the top priority is to find a supporter. It is best to go to a big monster, so that you can have a chance to obtain the practice method that truly belongs to the monster.
There is also a need to translate the book that came from the little girl as soon as possible. Maybe it is a cultivation method?
He vaguely remembered that the female devil had said something about the breathing method of the devil monks, which should be related to practice.
Thinking of this, Mo Fan couldn't help but said to himself: "Can monsters practice human cultivation methods?"
After thinking for a while, Mo Fan had two options in front of him. One was to find humans, and then learn to practice calligraphy and solve the contents of the book.
The other way is to find a great demon as a backer and obtain the demon cultivation method.
But when he took a look at the environment of the deep mountains and old forests around him, he knew that no matter which road he took, it seemed that it was not easy to walk.
"Forget it, let's find the way back to the cave first. Those three stones must be restored to the space in the body, so that we can use the coins to copy more!"
In Mo Fan's opinion, the milky white stone is definitely not a mortal thing, and may be used for some purpose in the future.
Of course, he not only wanted to go back and get the three stones, but also the cave full of milky white stones, which was worth exploring again.
Just like that, Mo Fan floated directly along the stream into the distance.
Because in his opinion, the creek where his cave is located is probably the same creek as this one!
Although this guess was based on deception, it turned out that Mo Fan was right.
After drifting along the creek for two full days, he finally saw the familiar environment, but he was pleasantly surprised.
When Mo Fan returned to the cave where he lived before, he was depressed to find that he could no longer enter because he was much larger than before.
In the end, Mo Fan could only bear the pain and dig, dig, dig, and finally destroyed the home where he had lived for several months...…
But after seeing the three milky-white stones with a faint halo, Mo Fan felt a lot more relaxed.
"Fortunately, they are all still there!"
He opened his mouth and took the three stones into his body, then took out another one and put it in his mouth, then walked towards the cave again without any hesitation.
